Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with a double gate: an exact fit wins, otherwise use worst fit only when the spread is at least the item size and at least three bins compete, and Best Fit otherwise. The choice differs from Best Fit when both conditions hold and no exact fit exists, since the loosest bin wins. The gate may avoid worst-fitting in narrow states, but it can rarely trigger and behave like Best Fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    spread = max(bins) - min(bins)
    n = len(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if spread >= item and n >= 3 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
